p_trade_method: For 1X2, p_external = 0.75 * sportsbook_consensus + 0.25 * Opta; for O/U 2.5, p_external = sportsbook_consensus. Then p_center = 0.75 * p_external + 0.25 * p_internal. uncertainty = max(0.5pp, 0.5 * sportsbook source dispersion + 0.1 * absolute internal/external disagreement + 0.25pp data-quality penalty). Directional p_trade is the lower bound p_center - uncertainty; complement outcomes are constructed from the coherent base probability before applying the same uncertainty. The uncalibrated scenario p10 remains diagnostic only.
evidence_gate: Only direct 1X2 and direct O/U 2.5 are eligible. Other scanned markets are excluded until a direct benchmark or validated projection model exists.
